description: #172 Fast: the public TemporalClusteredMap on flatRuntime="maps" sampling 2,000 moving tracks from one shared Map-Scoped Timeline over a static GeoJSON region grid, with the public timeline controls (e2e/fixtures/temporal-playback-journey.tsx).

tracks.removedEarly: every tenth track, offset five, with an invisible final keyframe
tracks.gaps: every seventh track, offset three, with an invisible middle keyframe

fixture.build: vite production build of the fixture with the built dist/wasm package

operations: navigate until the Map View is presented and Rust samples the tracks
8 clock seeks, each awaited until sampled and presented
drag the public timeline slider end to end in 40 pointer moves
drag the Map View 240x80 px in 24 steps
3 track source replacements, each awaited until sampled and presented
3 unmount/remount cycles of the Map View on the same clock
